SUMMARY

Project management professional with expertise in change leadership and business analysis. Proven ability to develop and implement effective solutions that enhance business operations. Delivered complex projects on schedule and within budget through effective cross-functional team managementwith skills in strategic planning, risk management, and resource allocation. Recognized for adaptability and problem-solving capabilities, fostering collaboration to achieve organizational goals.

SKILLS

Change management strategies

-Project Management - Business analysis

SDLC tools: JIRA, Confluence

-Microsoft Office Suite proficiency -Capital Market

Collateral management -OTC derivative Trade lifecycle -Risk management



Agile and Waterfall methodologies -Stakeholder Management -Regulatory Reporting

CERTIFICATE

Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by PMI. • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certified by Scrum Alliance.

PROJECTS UNDERTAKEN:

Strategic Stack Implementation for Trade Processing: Managed the transition of the



settlement cycle from T+1 to T0 of equity trades. IBOR Transition and FRTB IMA Project: Market risk change initiatives and Basel III compliance.

Centralized Platform Implementation: Developed a platform for middle office operations to meet regulatory requirements and process automate.

Strategic Contract Data Management Platform: Created a platform for OTC derivatives to support trade allocation, margin calculation, and regulatory compliance (EMIR, MIFID Initial Margin Regulation Implementation: Lead collateral management and contract data utility projects, including ISDA, CSA, IM, VM, and compliance with Dodd-Frank regulations.



For internal use only For internal use only

EXPERIENCE

Const. App. Program Manager/Rangam Info Tech (Bank of America Securities Limited) 2025

June

2024

Apr

Lead end-

to improvements and efficiencies

-end execution of strategic global program for Capital Market (Equity) with process

to reduced Settlement cycle from T1 to T0(GMOT team)

Develop and implement strategy for the identification, tracking and subsequent monitoring of project related items including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and associated costs and resources (RAID Log). • Collaborated with business leadership to prioritize initiatives based on needs, capacity, and risk assessment. • Conducted gap and feasibility analyses while liaising with senior stakeholders and project teams. • Monitored project progress using tools (RAG Report, Project score) ensuring timely delivery within budget. • Manage the consistency of the roadmap with the project milestones develop strategies and project plans, update project schedules and provide assistance in the planning milestone identification and key deliverables.

Facilitated weekly meetings with business and strategy teams, preparing presentations for steering committee reviews.

Maintained comprehensive project documentation to enhance communication and inform decision-making. • Coordinated communication between stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals. • Managed project schedules, resources, and risks to achieve objectives effectively.

AVP/Deutsche India Private limited (Change Lead) Nov2022 - Feb 2024 Initiated and executed projects for IBOR transition, enhancing risk management processes.

• Ensured implementation of VaR/SVaR, AGG codes, and new market data curves. • Requirements gathering from different Forps, defining the scope, business sign-off, UAT activities and post go live activity

Coordinated organization transitions, change readiness evaluations, and training programs. • Engaged with stakeholders to address market data queries and remediation activities promptly.

Senior Consultant/Capco Technology Private limited Dec 2021 - Nov 2022 • Served as project manager for Global Market Change Operations at leading Japanese Bank. • Collaborated with Global Change Management team -finance, compliance/legal and technology

transformation projects.

Streamlined processes to enhance program efficiency through implementation of time-saving solutions. • Compared current state to target operating model, identifying gaps in processes and systems. • Coordinated cross-functional teams to facilitate implementation of target operating model which will serve as golden source for Trade data.

Supported Senior Project Manager by engaging business owners and stakeholders in project planning. • Created and presented project roadmap and milestones to key stakeholders. • Lead weekly project meetings to ensure alignment with business objectives.

Senior (Team Lead)/EY GDS India ltd Sep 2014 - Dec 2021

Served as BA/PM for strategic contract data management platform for OTC derivatives process enhancement, automation and regulatory framework (EMIR,MiFID,CFTC, ISDA, Dodd Frank) • Collaborated with delivery team to create business requirements (BRDs) functional document (FSDs) Usecase, test plans, test cases.

Planned and managed backlog through interactions with business owners and stakeholders. • Led end- • Responsible for leading team of 8 members and ensuring its continuous growth. • Conducted UAT testing for new process implementation with an ability to identify risks involved and communicate with respective teams for resolution and ensure testing alignment with business requirements. go

For internal use only For internal use only

•

Implementation of processes/ process improvements, including automation of testing where possible and appropriate

Sr. Associate/Societe Generale Global Solution Centre TimeAug 2013 - Aug 2014

Product Control - Managed daily PnL production and analysis for designated trading books, focusing on S Bonds and CD (Fixed Income).

Explained significant PnL fluctuations based on book risk positions and market conditions. • • Addressed issues in PnL regeneration, delivering preliminary files to PnL controllers promptly. Investigated new and modified deals, ensuring compliance with tolerance levels and accurate market data.

Analyst/Deutsche Bank Operations International (DBOI)May 2010 - Aug 2013

Worked in collateral management team to coordinate with price providers, traders, and clients. • Managed margin calls when collateral exceeded thresholds and monitored MTA compliance. • Delivered valuation statements for trades and securities in OTC market to clients. • Reconciled economic and non-economic parameters of trades to ensure accuracy. • Oversaw margin process delivery and implemented controls for timely exception escalation. • Resolved client inquiries regarding valuations, holdings, and positions held. • Obtained prices and Mark- and Reuters.

Executed collateral management and valuation processes to maintain operational integrity

Ltd.

EDUCATION

MBA/Finance and Marketing Graduate in Bachelor of Commerce CFAI National College Sambalpur University Rourkela, Odisha/Jan 2010 Rourkela, Odisha /Jan 2008
